title: Vegan Pea Salad
description: A refreshing and easy-to-make salad perfect for a quick snack or light meal. Using crisp Canadian peas for added crunch.

ingredients.name: Canadian peas
ingredients.notes: Snap or cut into smaller pieces for added crunch

ingredients.name: Lively lettuce
ingredients.notes: Choose crisp lettuce for a fresh flavor

ingredients.name: Snap peas
ingredients.notes: Use fresh or frozen peas for added sweetness

ingredients.name: Vegan salad dressing
ingredients.notes: Make your own or use store-bought

instructions: 1. Rinse the peas and lettuce, and slice the snap peas.
2. In a large bowl, combine the peas, lettuce, and snap peas.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together the salad dressing ingredients.
4. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
